newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska wins Danish subway contract.
newsitem.headline: Skanska wins Danish subway contract.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska said on Tuesday its Danish subsidiary CG Jensen AS had won a contract to build a control and maintenance centre for Copenhagen's new subway (metro) system.
The centre will be used to control the subway's unmanned trains and house administrative and engineering functions.
The order is worth $19 million, Skanska said in a statement.
The client is Italian train maker Ansaldo Transporti SpA, which will be responsible for the subway operations for five years.
Work will start in October and be completed by April 1999.
Skanska said CG Jensen has also been commissioned by the Carlsberg brewing group to build a new $4 million distribution centre in the Danish capital.
Work has already started and is due to be finished in March next year.
